mapper.select: SELECT o.id orderId,COALESCE(f.due_date,o.current_due_date) dueDate,o.deposit_paid_amount_fen deposit,l.service_mode mode, COALESCE(rc.confirmed_at,ob.dispatch_at,ob.outbound_at) earliest, (s.shipment_status='sent' OR k.id IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE AS `returning`, (o.order_status IN ('completed','cancelled','user_cancelled') OR k.closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS closed, IF(l.service_mode='factory_pickup', COALESCE(l.dispatched_at,IF(s.operator_role='factory' AND s.shipment_status='sent',s.sent_at,NULL)),NULL) dispatch, IF(k.check_start_source IN ('factory_scan','admin_confirm'),k.check_start_at,NULL) arrival, IF(s.operator_role='buyer' AND s.tracking_no IS NOT NULL,'carrier',NULL) legacyMethod, IF(s.operator_role='buyer' AND s.shipment_status='sent',s.sent_at,NULL) legacyAt,COALESCE(s.remark,s.tracking_no) legacyBasis, f.id feeId,f.fee_status status,COALESCE(f.version,0) version,COALESCE(f.handover_method,f.reported_method) method, COALESCE(f.handover_at,f.reported_at) handoverAt,f.reported_basis basis,COALESCE(f.disputed,0) disputed, f.excluded_ms excludedMs,f.item_snapshot snapshot,f.rent_fen rent,f.liability_fen liability, f.rent_offset_fen rentOffset,f.liability_offset_fen liabilityOffset,f.review_basis reviewBasis,c.id receivableId, COALESCE(a.rent_allocated_amount_fen,0) rentPaid,COALESCE(a.compensation_allocated_amount_fen,0) liabilityPaid FROM rental_order o JOIN order_transport_leg l ON l.rental_order_id=o.id AND l.leg_type='return' LEFT JOIN order_receipt_check rc ON rc.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_outbound_record ob ON ob.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_return_shipment s ON s.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_return_check k ON k.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN rental_overdue_fee f ON f.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_compensation_receivable c ON c.source_type='overdue_return' AND c.source_id=f.id LEFT JOIN payment_allocation a ON a.payment_order_id=c.current_payment_order_id AND a.rental_order_id=o.id WHERE o.id=#{orderId}
SELECT id itemId,quantity,daily_rent_price_fen dailyRentFen FROM rental_order_item WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE rental_overdue_fee SET handover_method=#{method},handover_at=#{handoverAt},excluded_ms=#{excludedMs}, charge_days=#{days},item_snapshot=#{snapshot},rent_fen=#{rent},liability_fen=#{liability},rent_offset_fen=#{rentOffset}, liability_offset_fen=#{liabilityOffset},review_basis=#{basis},reviewed_by=#{actor},unreported_buyer_fault=#{fault},effective_at=#{now}, fee_status='effective',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND version=#{version} AND fee_status!='effective'
